cohort: The study included children born between 1977 and 2013 from Danish national registers, consisting of 6419 childhood cancer cases and 160484 matched controls.
finding: An obstetric comorbidity index, along with specific maternal conditions like pre-existing diabetes, previous cesarean delivery, and gestational hypertension, was found to predict an increased risk of childhood cancer.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was associated with increased cancer risks in offspring (OR = 1.20, 95%CI: 1.02-1.41).
